item.title: Learn to Self-Evaluate Instead of Slowly Criticizing Yourself
item.description: We are trained from childhood to wait for external grades, but we have never practiced self-assessment. It's not that we don't care; it's that we care too much, to the point where we are afraid to look.

item.title: Observing the Chain Reaction of My Parents' Emotions
item.description: A reflection on understanding parental emotions, the underlying vulnerability beneath displays of anger, and learning to establish healthy emotional boundaries.
